query: How do I check if a person is a Singapore Permanent Resident (PR)?
reference_answer: You may check the validity of the Re-entry Permit (REP) held by the person alongside a valid Identity Card (IC) or Digital IC (if available).
context:
[Document 1]
Singapore Permanent Residents (PR) are eligible to apply for Singapore citizenship two years after being granted Singapore PR status.

[Document 2]
You may enter as a Singapore Permanent Resident (PR) if your Re-Entry Permit (REP) is still valid. You would need to use your Singpass to access the ICA e-Service and transfer the remaining validity of your valid REP from the old to the new passport. Otherwise, you may be inconvenienced each time you travel in and out of Singapore.

[Document 3]
A Singapore permanent resident (SPR) who wishes to leave Singapore must obtain a Re-Entry Permit (REP) to enable him/her to return to Singapore as a SPR.  A SPR who remains outside Singapore without a valid REP will lose his/her PR status.

[Document 4]
If you have submitted your application on or after 26 June 2024, you may log in to the ICA e-Service with your reference number to check the status of your Singapore Citizenship, Permanent Residence or Long-Term Visit Pass application.You will be redirected to the Case Summary page where you can check your status enquiry.

[Document 5]
You can sponsor your parent(s) for Singapore Permanent Residence (PR) only if you are a Singapore citizen.
answer: To check if someone is a Singapore Permanent Resident (PR), they should use their Singpass to access the ICA e-Service and transfer the remaining validity of their valid Re-Entry Permit (REP) from their old passport to their new one. [Document 2] Additionally, one can check the status of their application on the ICA e-Service using their reference number. [Document 4]
